technology_name: METHOD OF IMPROVING RETENTION CHARACTERISTICS IN AMORPHOUS OXIDE SEMICONDUCTOR BASED OPTOELECTRONIC SYNAPTIC DEVICE
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Amorphous oxide semiconductor optoelectronic synaptic devices exhibit poor charge retention and volatile short-term memory (STM) traits that hinder long-term potentiation efficiency.
description: An optimization methodology that applies specialized gate voltage sequences coupled with pre-synaptic UV light stimuli onto a synaptic device layered with a gate terminal, insulating barrier, and photoconductive thin film to smoothly tune long-term memory (LTM) retention.
applications: Neuromorphic computing hardware architectures, optoelectronic artificial brains, bio-inspired optical sensors, and advanced machine learning edge accelerators.
